title: AC1032 TABLECONTENT bounded raw-only shell recovery

source.provenance: Tracked external ACadSharp sample; used read-only, not copied into this repository.

authority.oda: ODA v5.4.1 §2 requires R2007+ object Unicode strings in the detached string stream; §20.4.99 describes TABLECONTENT value strings as TV. The peer's body-byte-count interpretation remains unreconciled.
authority.implementationPolicy: Do not change TABLECONTENT field parsing or infer semantic values. Preserve only the common shell and exact raw frame when the typed parser fails and RawObjectShell validates.

typedFailureTrace.interpretation: The ordinary parser's cursor reaches code 0x5 at its interpreted first cell-attribute slot. The subsequent body/string span probe shows that this interpretation is likely displaced; see handleAndBodySpanRecheck. It does not establish a producer/spec role violation or qualify typed payload or output.
typedFailureTrace.codeChange: Added debug-only boundary diagnostics in src/drw_entities.cpp; no parser interpretation or output behavior changed.

handleAndBodySpanRecheck.interpretation: A debug-only alternate parse treats the type-4 value as a BL byte-counted body string, then reads unit 0, zero attributes, content-format fields and the observed code-0x5 text-style handle. Both records reach the exact body boundary and consume all but one terminal handle bit. This explains the ordinary parser's 32/80 attribute counts and role mismatch as a likely cursor displacement; it does not independently establish the candidate schema. The 17-bit pre-handle string gap is not decoded, the alternate typed projections remain semantically incomplete, and the candidate conflicts with ODA v5.4.1 §§2 and 20.4.99.
handleAndBodySpanRecheck.implementationPolicy: Keep the production interpretation, raw-only fallback and strict-output refusal unchanged. Resolve the candidate's complete string/handle framing and its conflict with the authoritative ODA text before adopting it.

peerParserRecheck.interpretation: These malformed-looking nested values and premature geometry boundaries show that this local peer build is also desynchronized on the same sample. It is not independent field/span evidence and cannot resolve the ODA role mismatch.
peerParserRecheck.fixturePolicy: Input is the existing external ACadSharp sample; no file was copied into this repository.

implementation.behavior: For only AC1032 TABLECONTENT / AcDbTableContent, a failed typed-body parse may publish raw-only after an independent RawObjectShell validates the common header and handle tail. The raw carrier has typedPayloadValidated=false and no TableContent callback is sent. An invalid shell remains failed. Strict output remains blocked by the raw-object/context replay gates.

coverage: raw-only publication occurs only after AC1032 shell validation
the full source payload, class identity and common owner/reactor roles are retained
no typed TABLECONTENT callback is sent for the raw-only source
a following typed associative object still publishes
the generated body is deliberately not a TABLECONTENT schema vector

physicalRead.result: Read completed; CLI returned 1 because strict DXF preparation correctly refused the existing standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA replay gate.

spanDiagnosticValidation.scope: Debug diagnostics and raw-only recovery validation only; no TABLECONTENT production interpretation or support claim changed.

verification.fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added; the regression control is generated in memory.

scopeLimit: This closes raw frame publication for the two current AC1032 TABLECONTENT objects only. The debug-only body-byte-count candidate reaches the body boundary and nearly consumes each handle stream, but its 17-bit string gap, one terminal handle bit and conflict with ODA remain unresolved. It does not recover production typed cell values, establish output support, qualify other versions or producers, or establish native TABLE rendering.
